Lines 124-136 cover exit, SIGINT, and SIGTERM. No process can guarantee cleanup after its own SIGKILL.

Decoder contract: decode-parity P4 and P5 prove text precedence over forged result branches across the scorer, queue, and judge. The full adversarial-p4c file also passes J1 and J2. No decoder parity defect reproduced.

Static checks: git diff --check and bash -n passed. daemon_pids, error_line_of, and error_all_events_text are byte-identical across both runners. The frozen-path diff and public-page diff are empty. The production patch contains zero matches for the checked credential patterns.

Audit limits: I read no real credential store, private key, seeded diff, or raw model output. I called no model, browser, opencode CLI, or openchamber CLI. Review A and Review B provide supporting context, not replacement test results. No CONTEST item was supplied.

The first wrapped Bun command exceeded the shell tool timeout before it printed output. The retry disabled that outer timeout and passed. The parser matrix and foreign-process reproduction also completed. No matching fake or quota server remains. No test file, implementation, plan, registry, or committed file changed during this audit. Facts changed: none.

PM cap: only a real credential leak into a committed file or public page blocks this review. No such leak was found. F1 through F4 remain nonblocking under that rule. This result does not claim live seed success, a reachable Hy route, or phase acceptance.
